fusions.name: Tongue Pin
fusions.desc: A tongue lash that deals 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Through the Gap
fusions.desc: Spits a needle-fine jet that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Found the Gap
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Reflex
fusions.desc: When you strike, a barb flicks to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
